description: A single line drawn with straight segments between readings instead of a smoothed curve.
overview: One series joined by straight segments instead of a smoothed curve. Prefer it to the default when smoothing would imply values between readings that were never measured.
usage: Replace `chartData`, update each `dataKey` and set the label and color in `chartConfig`. Everything else matches the default line chart.
notes: Keyboard users can focus the chart and move between points with the arrow keys.
